title: Cue Up the Easy Mark!

Two balls will be dropped into the RS pocket, and their numbers will have a difference of 5. The 9 ball will be dropped into the TRC pocket. No two sequential shots will go into the same pocket. He is amazing, sinking shot after shot – sometimes with balls jumping over other balls – and he always manages to stop the cue ball right where it contacts the ball he is sinking.
